cat > /tmp/auto_restart_judges.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
RESP_DIR="/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/data/arena_hard/responses"
EXP_DIR="/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001"
LLAMA_DONE=0
QWEN_DONE=0

while true; do
  if [ $LLAMA_DONE -eq 0 ]; then
    LLAMA_COUNT=$(wc -l < "${RESP_DIR}/llama-3.3-70b.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') llama: ${LLAMA_COUNT}/500"
    if [ "$LLAMA_COUNT" -ge 500 ]; then
      echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') llama DONE! Starting judge collection..."
      cd $EXP_DIR
      tmux new-session -d -s judge-llama "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001 && python collect.py --config config_llama_arena.yaml --workers 8 --generate-judge-responses 2>&1 | tee /tmp/judge_llama_collect.log"
      LLAMA_DONE=1
      echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') judge-llama tmux session started"
    fi
  fi

  if [ $QWEN_DONE -eq 0 ]; then
    QWEN_COUNT=$(wc -l < "${RESP_DIR}/qwen2.5-72b.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') qwen: ${QWEN_COUNT}/500"
    if [ "$QWEN_COUNT" -ge 500 ]; then
      echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') qwen DONE! Starting judge collection..."
      cd $EXP_DIR
      tmux new-session -d -s judge-qwen "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001 && python collect.py --config config_qwen_arena.yaml --workers 8 --generate-judge-responses 2>&1 | tee /tmp/judge_qwen_collect.log"
      QWEN_DONE=1
      echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') judge-qwen tmux session started"
    fi
  fi

  if [ $LLAMA_DONE -eq 1 ] && [ $QWEN_DONE -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "$(date '+%H:%M:%S') Both judges restarted. Script exiting."
    break
  fi

  sleep 180
done
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/auto_restart_judges.sh && echo "script created"
tmux new-session -d -s auto-restart "bash /tmp/auto_restart_judges.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/auto_restart_judges.log" && echo "tmux session started"
